title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise AI
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
## An overview of this role
As an Applied AI Engineer at GitLab, you'll build and deploy AI-powered solutions for GitLab's own teams. You'll join Enterprise AI in the CIO organization, reporting to the Senior Director, Enterprise AI. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll write production code and partner with senior engineers and internal business stakeholders to solve problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Your focus is GitLab's internal operations, rather than customer implementations or development of the GitLab product.
Building fast matters, and we want engineers who ship. But speed without understanding the problem leads to the wrong solution shipped quickly. You'll partner with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand the real problem first: how work moves across teams, where the real constraint lives, and whether AI is the right intervention. From there, you'll take ownership of the build and deployment, combining strong engineering skills with curiosity about the business systems you're improving.
Your initial focus will span GitLab's own Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support teams, where you'll embed AI solutions into the systems and workflows they use every day. This role offers the opportunity to grow as an engineer while shaping how GitLab team members work, in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.
## What you'll do
• Contribute to problem diagnosis alongside the team. Engage with stakeholders to understand the real constraint before reaching for a solution, and be willing to flag when AI isn't the right answer.
• Own the build and deployment of AI solutions, from technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration. Partner with senior engineers on discovery and scoping.
• Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.
• Build solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Track flow, adoption, and ROI metrics defined for the work.
• Integrate AI capabilities into GitLab's internal business systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.
• Be Customer Zero: use GitLab's AI products in our own internal workflows, assess how they perform in practice, and share feedback with R&D to help improve them.
• Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions. Ask good questions, surface assumptions, and align with the team on outcomes before jumping to implementation.
• Track success against defined business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.
• Contribute to documentation and reusable patterns that help the team scale its impact.
## What you'll bring
• A Technologist at Heart - Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energized by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.
Competent, Confident Coding Skills - You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently.AI & LLM Technical Depth - Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Practical, hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, specifically:
• Prompt engineering as a core discipline: designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.
• Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs: developing judgment on when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to think about capability versus cost.
• Agentic architecture patterns: tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.
• Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem: hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and growing judgment about which to reach for and when.
• AI Safety & Risk Awareness - You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defenses, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.
• Curiosity About Flow & Constraints - Comfortable engaging with workflow maps, end-to-end process diagrams, and constraint analysis. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?" You don't need to be the one leading the diagnosis yet, but you should be eager to learn and contribute.
• Business System Awareness - Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems: CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but you should understand what they do, be willing to learn how they fit together, and be ready to build with and across them.
• Cross-Functional Communication - Comfortable having conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains, willing to invest in understanding their unique needs, and able to translate between technical and business language.
• Ownership Mindset - Track record of taking scoped initiatives from design through delivery. Comfortable operating with some ambiguity, and knows when to push forward independently versus when to ask for guidance.
• Product Mindset - Ability to scope MVPs, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver iteratively. In addition, consider adoption, user experience, and business outcomes.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with GitLab platform and CI/CD workflows
• Background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, consulting, or other stakeholder-facing technical roles, combining strong engineering skills with stakeholder engagement, solution design, and root cause analysis. Experience personally building and shipping production-quality solutions is especially relevant.
• Familiarity with value stream mapping, flow metrics, or Theory of Constraints thinking
• Experience with low-code/no-code orchestration tools (n8n, Make, Workato) alongside custom development
• Previous startup or high-growth company experience
## About the team
You will join the Enterprise Technology & AI team in the CIO organization. We build and improve the internal systems and workflows that help GitLab team members make decisions, operate at scale, and do their best work.
We believe the best AI solutions start with understanding the system, not the technology. We value people who think in constraints and flow, who build with conviction, and who never stop learning. We work in an all-remote, asynchronous setting, guided by GitLab's operating principles of Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, built on a Culture of Excellence.
## How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
• Flexible Paid Time Off
• Team Member Resource Groups
• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• Growth and Development Fund
• Parental Leave
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Applied AI Architect, Technology Partnerships
description:
## About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## About the role
As an Applied AI Architect on the Technology Partnerships team at Anthropic, you will be the technical lead for strategic ISV and technology partners building unique product integrations with Claude. These are software companies whose platforms are systems of record for their customers, and who want those customers to be able to work with their data and workflows directly inside Claude.
This role goes deep with each partner. You will own the technical side of product partnerships from first scoping through launch and beyond. You will help partners design how their platform shows up in Claude (MCP servers, connectors, plugins, and skills), hold the quality bar through evaluations, and act as the bridge between the partner's product and engineering teams and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams. You will be a trusted technical advisor to partner engineering leaders and executives, and you will turn what you learn into patterns and playbooks that make every future integration faster and better.
## Responsibilities
Technical ownership of strategic integrations: Serve as the technical lead for strategic ISV and technology partners building product integrations with Claude. Own the technical plan from use-case definition and scoping through build, launch, and post-launch iteration.
Integration architecture: Advise partners on how to expose their platform to Claude, including MCP server design, tool and API surface design for large platforms, authentication and admin onboarding, permissions, and plugin and skill structure. Be opinionated about the patterns that lead to the best experience for joint customers.
Evaluations and quality: Design and run evaluations of partner integrations against the use cases that matter most to joint customers. Turn results into concrete, prioritized feedback for partner engineering teams and hold a high quality bar before launch.
Hands-on prototyping: Build prototypes, demos, and reference skills that show partners the art of the possible, accelerate their build, and contribute to product improvements.
Launch readiness: Partner with Product, Partnerships, Marketing, and GTM teams to get integrations launch-ready on partner-driven timelines such as customer conferences and product events, and support partners and early customers through launch.
Product and research feedback loop: Act as the connective tissue between partners and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams. Surface integration gaps and platform requirements, help shape the roadmap for how Claude works with third-party software, and bring early capabilities to partners.
Executive technical relationships: Build trusted relationships with partner CTOs, product leaders, and engineering leads. Explain technical tradeoffs and Anthropic's point of view clearly to technical and executive audiences alike.
Scale what works: Codify reference architectures, integration best practices, evaluation approaches, self-serve guidance, and playbooks so each new technology partnership starts from a stronger foundation, and help enable account teams and the broader partner ecosystem.
Joint customer success: Support account teams on strategic joint customers adopting partner integrations, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
## You may be a good fit if you have
8+ years of experience in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Engineer, Developer Relations Engineer, or Technical Account Manager, or as a software engineer on platform, API, or integrations work
A track record of leading complex technical integrations with ISVs or technology partners, from solution design through launch
Deep experience with APIs, platform integration, and enterprise SaaS architecture, including authentication and authorization models, permissions, and admin experience
Hands-on familiarity with LLM applications and agentic tooling, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use, agents, and evaluation frameworks
Strong coding ability; you can build prototypes, write evals, and work in a real codebase (comfort with Python or TypeScript expected)
Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives and engineering leaders
Product sense, and the judgment to know when to push a partner toward a better design and when to adapt to their constraints
Comfort operating in early-stage, ambiguous environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet, and a track record of building structure as you go
Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
## How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
## Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: Cyber Partner Applied AI Architect
description:
About the Team

Frontier AI is changing how organizations discover vulnerabilities, remediate risk and defend their environments. Realizing that potential at scale will take an ecosystem of partners who can put the technology to work. The Cyber Partnerships Team works to bring together providers of cybersecurity products, systems integrators, and our hyperscaler partners to accelerate deployment of this technology to enterprises around the world.

Within the team, Partner Applied AI Architects work with strategic partners—including global and regional system integrators, consulting and advisory firms, and technology partners—to extend OpenAI’s technical reach and help partners deliver high-quality AI solutions for our joint customers. We bring together technical strategy, partner enablement, architecture expertise, and practical deployment experience, working closely with Partnerships, Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, and specialist cybersecurity teams.

About the Role

As a Cyber Partner Applied AI Architect, you will be a senior technical advisor to a portfolio of strategic cybersecurity partners and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership and delivery organizations. You will shape how partners build practices around OpenAI, develop solutions using our products, and take joint customers from unmet cybersecurity needs and technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.

You will own the technical strategy and architecture across partner engagements involving our Daybreak access programs, specialized cybersecurity products, existing non-cybersecurity product portfolio, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with the broader partnerships team, you will translate joint business priorities into technical strategies, solution patterns, enablement plans, and a focused portfolio of high-value customer opportunities.

You will work directly with partners on strategic customer engagements—leading discovery, shaping architectures, navigating complex technical decisions, and helping secure technical wins—while building the partner capabilities required to deliver successfully and independently at scale.

You will remain accountable for the technical quality and outcomes of the partnership while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, security, product, enablement, and other teams when deeper expertise is needed. The role calls for strong architectural judgment, executive presence, partner leadership, and the ability to move confidently between business strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

In this role, you will:

 - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for cybersecurity practices across a portfolio of strategic partners, building trusted relationships with their executives, AI leaders, architects, engineering teams, and delivery organizations.

 - Partner closely with the broader partnerships team as one virtual team, aligning partner strategy, technical priorities, joint customer opportunities, and measures of success.

 - Develop the technical strategy and plan for each partner, identifying priority solutions, use cases, technical capabilities, enablement needs, delivery risks, and opportunities to drive customer adoption.

 - Assess prospective and existing partners’ cybersecurity capabilities and delivery readiness, identifying strengths, gaps, and the investments required to successfully deliver OpenAI-powered solutions.

 - Lead technical discovery with partners and joint customers to identify, qualify, and prioritize cybersecurity use-cases.

 - Develop clear Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, enterprise data, integrations, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

 - Guide partners through their initial and most strategic cybersecurity deployments, helping them navigate technical tradeoffs and production dependencies while ensuring solutions meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and responsible deployment.

 - Build partner capability and technical self-sufficiency through tailored enablement, architectural guidance, reusable solution patterns, technical workshops, and mentorship.

 - Establish clear standards and mechanisms for partner-delivered solution quality, identifying risks early and intervening when architecture, implementation, security, evaluation, or adoption issues threaten customer outcomes.

 - Orchestrate the right OpenAI specialists across Deployment Engineering, Product, Security, implementation, enablement, and domain teams while maintaining clear ownership and handoffs between OpenAI and partner delivery teams.

 - Track partner capability, joint pipeline technical progress, production adoption, usage, solution quality, and measurable customer impact to identify where additional investment or intervention is needed.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across partner engagements and turn them into architectures, playbooks, reference solutions, and best practices that allow successful approaches to scale across partners and customers.

 - Bring insights from partners and joint customers back to Product, Engineering, Research, and Partnerships, helping shape product strategy, technical guidance, and the broader OpenAI partner ecosystem.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have significant experience in senior cybersecurity roles either at firms specializing in providing cybersecurity solutions or technology, or as a senior cybersecurity leader at an enterprise company with meaningful scale

 - Have worked successfully with global or regional system integrators, consulting firms, or other technology partners, and understand how partner organizations sell, architect, and deliver complex enterprise technology.

 - Can build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, partner executives, and AI leaders while communicating equally effectively with architects and hands-on engineers.

 - Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, enterprise data, integrations, identity, security, privacy, and governance.

 - Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLMs, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, and enterprise AI workflows.

 - Can prototype when useful, explain technical tradeoffs clearly, and work confidently to connect discrete cybersecurity products, tools, and approaches into cohesive solutions.

 - Have experience enabling technical organizations at scale, turning your own expertise into repeatable architectures, training, patterns, and practices that others can successfully apply.

 - Understand enterprise security and compliance requirements and can guide partners and customers through the technical considerations required to move AI systems safely into production.

 - Are comfortable balancing the needs of OpenAI, the partner, and the end customer, and can exercise sound judgment when those priorities do not perfectly align.

 - Know when to go deep personally, when to coach a partner toward the answer, and when to engage specialist resources.

 - Can prioritize across a portfolio of partners and customer opportunities, focusing technical resources on the work most likely to create durable customer value and adoption.

 - Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical architecture, executive decision, enablement plan, or path to production.

 - Own problems end-to-end, learn quickly, and care deeply about helping partners and customers deploy advanced AI responsibly.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. title: Software Developer, CPT / NCRT (SCM DSO)
description:
Overview
TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Software Developer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.
The Software Developer will support the development, sustainment, and modernization of two VA healthcare supply chain applications: the Clinical Product Tool (CPT) and National Contingency Response Tool (NCRT).
This position is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining full-stack applications, resolving software defects, addressing cybersecurity vulnerabilities, and supporting cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
## Both applications are Java-based
web applications built on the SEMOSS platform. CPT utilizes TypeScript and PostgreSQL and is transitioning to the VA Enterprise Cloud on Microsoft Azure. NCRT utilizes React and Apache Tomcat and operates within the VA Enterprise Cloud on AWS.
At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.
TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!
Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, and maintain software features and enhancements for CPT and NCRT applications.
• Develop and support full-stack applications using Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and relational databases.
• Collaborate with technical leads, architects, and development teams to implement application enhancements and resolve defects.
• Address application security vulnerabilities identified through automated code scanning and security assessments.
• Support the migration of CPT to the VA Enterprise Cloud on Microsoft Azure.
• Update application configurations, troubleshoot migration issues, and validate functionality across cloud environments.
• Perform application and platform upgrades involving SEMOSS, Apache Tomcat, and related technologies.
• Maintain and enhance NCRT functionality, including defect resolution and application performance improvements.
• Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and regression tests.
• Participate in code reviews to ensure software quality, security, and adherence to development standards.
• Support database development, queries, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
• Utilize Git and automated build tools to support version control and software delivery.
• Collaborate with cybersecurity, testing, and configuration management teams to support application releases.
• Investigate and resolve escalated help desk tickets and production issues.
• Maintain technical documentation, including application configurations, development changes, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and continuous improvement activities.
Qualifications
• Minimum four years of professional software development experience.
• Strong experience developing and maintaining Java-based web applications.
• Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks, particularly React, using JavaScript or TypeScript.
• Experience developing and supporting full-stack applications, including front-end, back-end, and database components.
• Experience working with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
• Experience identifying and remediating application security vulnerabilities, including SQL injection and other code scanning findings.
• Experience using Git for source code management and version control.
• Experience with automated build processes, software testing, and continuous integration practices.
• Understanding of Agile software development methodologies and collaborative development environments.
• Experience troubleshooting application defects and supporting production systems.
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, architects, testers, cybersecurity teams, and technical leadership.

title: Voice and Hosted Cloud Connect Product Architect
description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives.Come join the excellence!
## Overview
The Voice and Hosted Cloud Connect Product Architect, working within TNS’s Communications market and under the Global Network Planning umbrella, will work to support the design and deployment related to LTE and 5G Roaming, and IMS/VoLTE services involving both signaling and user plane traffic. This position needs SME knowledge of voice interconnects via legacy- and VoIP-modeled systems; integration and testing support; SS7, SIP, ENUM, REST, and Diameter protocols; and cross-functional work experience.
## Responsibilities
• Serve as the lead or supporting architect for TNS voice, VoIP, Hosted Cloud Connect, cloud communications, and carrier voice products.
• Establish and maintain end-to-end architecture for Hosted Cloud Connect and associated voice services, including application, signaling, media, routing, security, monitoring, provisioning, billing, and operational-support components.
• Translate Product roadmaps, customer requirements, commercial opportunities, and operational needs into documented technical architectures, implementation plans, product requirements, and engineering deliverables.
• Partner with Product Management to evaluate and develop new voice capabilities, including call recording, softphone services, network call screening, carrier-direct voice services, call authentication, and other cloud-based voice applications.
• Support Sales, Business Development, and Product teams during customer discovery, solution design, technical presentations, feasibility assessments, and responses to complex customer requirements.
• Provide architectural leadership for integrations involving newly acquired voice platforms, third-party applications, internal TNS infrastructure, and external carrier or cloud environments.
• Lead architectural planning for voice-platform modernization, consolidation, migration, and retirement initiatives, including the transition of services between legacy and strategic platforms.
• Work directly with strategic technology partners and vendors, including Ribbon and other voice-platform providers, to evaluate roadmaps, resolve design or interoperability issues, and influence product capabilities needed by TNS.
• Define voice service call flows, application interactions, routing logic, resiliency models, failover behavior, capacity requirements, security controls, and service-quality requirements.
• Provide technical leadership for interoperability, integration, performance, resiliency, and customer-acceptance testing across SIP, IMS, SBC, media, application-server, and carrier-interconnect environments.
• Support the investigation and resolution of complex production issues involving SIP call flows, call routing, media, interoperability, voice applications, SBCs, service platforms, and carrier interconnections.
• Ensure new and modified voice products meet development, security, operational, monitoring, capacity, support, and commercial-readiness requirements before production deployment.
• Identify architectural risks, platform dependencies, technical debt, scalability limitations, concentration-of-knowledge risks, and opportunities for simplification or automation.
• Maintain current and target-state architecture documentation, including:
• Product Architecture Design Documents
• High-level and detailed solution diagrams
• SIP call-flow and service-interaction diagrams
• Platform integration and dependency models
• Make-versus-buy analyses
• Technical and operational impact assessments
• Capacity and scalability models
• Resiliency and failover scenarios
• Monitoring and event-management requirements
• Development, QA, and test-environment requirements
• Security and compliance requirements
• Test strategies and test-result assessments
• Deployment, migration, and operational-readiness plans
• Product lifecycle and platform-retirement recommendations
• Communicate architectural decisions, alternatives, risks, costs, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Provide technical mentorship and domain guidance to Engineering, Operations, Product, and other architecture resources to broaden organizational voice and HCC expertise.
## Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
• Seven or more years of telecommunications experience, with significant experience designing, integrating, deploying, or supporting carrier-grade voice, VoIP, or cloud communications solutions.
• Demonstrated experience in voice application, solution, or product architecture, including the ability to take a voice capability from business concept and customer requirements through technical design, testing, deployment, and operational readiness.
• Deep knowledge of SIP, SIP call flows, session management, call routing, number translation, media negotiation, voice interconnection, and common voice-service failure scenarios.
• Experience with Hosted Cloud Connect, Ribbon voice platforms, Ribbon session border controllers, Ribbon application platforms, or comparable carrier-grade voice and cloud communications technologies is strongly preferred.
• Experience architecting solutions involving several of the following:
• Session border controllers
• Softswitches and call-control platforms
• Telephony application servers
• Media resource functions and media gateways
• Call recording platforms
• Softphone and unified communications applications
• Network call-screening or call-protection services
• Carrier voice interconnection
• Voice routing and least-cost routing
• Toll-free, DID, and telephone-number management
• STIR/SHAKEN and call-authentication services
• Voice provisioning, billing, monitoring, and service-assurance systems
• Strong working knowledge of SIP, SDP, RTP, RTCP, DNS, ENUM, REST APIs, TLS, TCP/IP, and voice codecs.
• Working knowledge of SS7, ISUP, TCAP, SCCP, Diameter, IMS, and PSTN gateways, sufficient to support integrations with legacy and mobile-network environments.
• Experience designing highly available, geographically resilient, secure, and scalable carrier-grade voice solutions.
• Experience with public or private cloud architecture, virtualization, containers, APIs, and platform integration as applied to telecommunications or real-time communications is preferred.
• Experience developing capacity models and defining performance, availability, resiliency, monitoring, and disaster-recovery requirements for voice platforms.
• Experience integrating acquired products or third-party platforms into an established technology, operational, security, and commercial environment is preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate competing technologies and vendors, conduct make-versus-buy analyses, identify architectural trade-offs, and make clear technical recommendations.
• Experience working directly with Product Management, Sales, customers, software development teams, network engineering, operations, security teams, and technology vendors.
• Ability to troubleshoot complex end-to-end voice issues across application, signaling, media, network, carrier, and customer domains.
• Ability to communicate complex voice architectures, risks, and recommendations clearly in written documents, diagrams, technical discussions, and executive-level presentations.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple competing priorities, and provide architectural leadership in a dynamic product and customer environment.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and architecture-design tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or an equivalent diagramming platform.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.
***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.
## A day in the life:
You'll sit on the Data Team, which owns the core data foundation for Power Digital: the pipelines, modeling, and data marts that power our agency teams, clients, and AI initiatives. You'll work end to end, from raw ingestion through the semantic layer, using AI-agentic workflows as a normal part of how you build.
The data itself is the interesting part. Marketing data is fragmented by default. Every ad platform has its own API, its own schema, and its own definition of a conversion. Platforms restate attributed conversions days after the fact, each in a different way. Entity hierarchies don't match (campaign/ad set/ad on Meta, campaign/ad group/ad on Google). Naming conventions, currencies, and timezones vary by client.
We do this across a large client portfolio, each client with a different stack, in a warehouse with per-client tenancy. You'll work closely with Client Service, BI, Tagging & Tracking, Data Ops, and the nova product/engineering teams.
## Key Responsibilities:
• Design, build, and maintain the core data foundation (ingestion, modeling, and data marts), owning the workflow from raw platform data through the serving layers that support agency, client, internal, and AI consumers.
• Build ingestion that handles what ad platforms actually do: API changes, deprecated fields, aggressive rate limits, and retroactive restatement of conversion data, all without corrupting downstream models.
• Model across sources so the numbers reconcile: spend, impressions, conversions, and revenue across Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, LinkedIn, and Microsoft, plus customer-level joins across Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4, and client CRMs.
• Contribute to client-bespoke modeling on top of the core layer: custom logic, overrides, and client-specific marts built in response to individual client requests, with patterns that extend the shared foundation rather than fork it. This is steady, recurring work, not an occasional exception.
• Build the semantic layers and metric definitions that let AI-generated SQL return consistent, correct answers.
• Use AI-agentic workflows, including AI coding tools, to accelerate development and build intelligent data infrastructure. Document what works so it becomes a standard team pattern.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with nova (product and engineering), AI/innovation, and client teams to translate requirements into data solutions and support rapid iteration on new products and features.
• Monitor and resolve data quality issues, and optimize pipelines for cost and performance across a multi-client warehouse.
## Role Requirements:
• 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ years owning a dbt project of meaningful size in production, not just contributing models to one.
• Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with a focus on production-grade code for data pipelines and modeling.
• Deep expertise in dbt, not just writing models. Incremental strategies and full-refresh tradeoffs, Jinja and macros, packages, generic and singular tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and how to keep a large project's DAG and materializations under control.
• Strong command of Snowflake and the surrounding cloud data stack to operate autonomously as a foundational data owner.
• Experience modeling in a multi-tenant environment, with the judgment to know when a client request belongs in a client layer and when it belongs in the core.
• Working knowledge of marketing and advertising datasets. You've handled UTMs, attribution windows, and the gap between platform-reported and warehouse-reported conversions.
• Proven experience designing and managing end-to-end data lifecycles from ingestion to serving, with reliability that holds for both BI and AI applications.
• Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (GCP) and infrastructure-as-code principles.
• Real adoption of AI-agentic development workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) for coding, debugging, and system architecture.
• Demonstrated ability to architect AI-ready data models (feature stores, clean semantic layers) that support downstream initiatives.
• Experience with Git and CI/CD best practices, including automated testing you trust.
• Comfortable shipping iteratively and refining data products based on live feedback.
## Helpful but not required
• Agency, consultancy, or services experience. Working across many clients with different stacks transfers directly.
• Measurement work: incrementality, media mix modeling, attribution.
• Server-side tagging, or retail and marketplace data.
## You might be a fit if…
• You're a data engineer at a brand or retailer and want to work closer to the decisions your data drives.
• You've built marketing pipelines at an agency or martech company and know how they break.
• You're an analytics engineer who wants to own the full system rather than just the modeling layer.
• You've rebuilt your own workflow around AI coding agents and want that to be the job.
## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• AI-accelerated development. Reduce median development time from approved requirements to production deployment for new data pipeline and modeling requests by 20% within the first 6 months, using the team's established baseline for comparable requests. Document and productionize at least 1 reusable AI-agentic development pattern within the first 90 days and at least 2 within the first 12 months, with each pattern adopted in at least 2 production workflows or projects.
• Data quality and reliability. Maintain ≥99% accuracy and completeness across fields designated as critical for client-facing and AI-facing data products, measured through automated data quality tests and reconciliations. Maintain a ≥95% successful scheduled pipeline execution rate for owned production pipelines, excluding documented upstream vendor/platform outages.
• Client request throughput. Deliver ≥90% of assigned client-bespoke modeling requests within the agreed-upon turnaround time, measured quarterly. Where a bespoke request introduces logic applicable across clients, evaluate and document whether it belongs in the shared core or client-specific layer for 100% of material modeling changes.
• Cross-functional enablement. Launch or materially migrate at least 2 major production data assets within the first 12 months that support agency, client, product, or AI consumers. Within 90 days of each launch, demonstrate adoption through at least 2 active downstream consumers, applications, or teams per asset and achieve either a 20% reduction in related recurring data-support tickets or another pre-defined adoption/efficiency target agreed upon before launch.
## Most Important Things (MITs)
• Build and ship end-to-end data systems that enable AI features.
• Deliver production-ready datasets and pipelines that unblock AI, product, and client teams.
• Reduce fragmentation by building unified, AI-ready data foundations

About Our Company:
Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.
About the Position:
Cologix is looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Systems Administration team. This role will be responsible for development and engineering of internal solutions that support the core business operation. Primary functions will be designing, deploying and monitoring automation services between various business systems; reviewing, analyzing and streamlining current business processes and systems; assisting with designing, deploying and management of core business systems.
## What you do daily:
• Contribute to the implementation of new products while supporting the ongoing development, maintenance, and optimization of DevOps practices across Engineering.
• Collaborate with vendors, engineering teams, and peer operations organizations to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
• Develop and establish organizational standards, policies, procedures, and best practices for DevOps environments.
• Design and implement simple, repeatable, and reliable solutions that streamline systems, processes, and operational workflows.
• Own and coordinate release management activities to support consistent, controlled, and successful deployments.
• Establish, maintain, and support systems and tools used across development and production environments.
• Develop, administer, and maintain version control systems and associated processes.
• Maintain a comprehensive documentation library for DevOps systems, processes, and procedures.
• Create technical and operational documentation for new systems and solutions to enable effective transition and knowledge transfer to operational support teams.
## What makes you a good fit: (Qualifications)
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical discipline (preference), or equivalent professional experience.
• 3+ years of experience in DevOps
• 3+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or a related role.
• Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix system administration and networking fundamentals.
• Experience with automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible or equivalent technologies.
• Experience working with a variety of open-source technologies and cloud platforms.
• Working knowledge of Apache, Tomcat, MySQL, and JVM-based server environments.
• Familiarity with scripting and programming languages such as Python, PHP, Perl, and/or Ruby.
• Strong understanding of IT operations best practices within highly available, production-critical environments.
• Ability to work independently, effectively manage priorities, and take ownership of assigned projects and tasks.
• Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and operational teams.
• A proactive, positive approach with a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously develop new skills.
• AWS architecture certification, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, is a plus.
***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or transfer sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

Benefits:
We offer a competitive benefit package for full-time employees that includes:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Company paid Life Insurance
Voluntary supplemental life insurance
Flexible spending account
Health savings account
Non-accrued PTO
Short- and Long-Term Disability
Company paid holidays
401k Retirement Plan with employer match
Mental Wellness Benefits
Tuition Reimbursement
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Discount Marketplace
Employee Recognition Platform
Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual bonus.

Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status. • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field. GPA of 3.5 or more
• Familiarity with SQL and Python.
• Understanding of basic cloud concepts (AWS preferred).
• Proven experience with industry-grade database solutions and with AWS (1+ years)
• Experience with ETL creation
• Agentic experience when it comes to the above
• 1+ years of relevant past internships
• Strong interest in data analysis and automation..
• Eagerness to learn and contribute to a fast-paced, remote engineering team.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Availability of at least 20 hours per week for at least 6 months
## Location
• US/CA Remote
## What We Offer
• Paid internship with flexible scheduling.
• Remote-first work culture and support.
• Hands-on mentorship from senior engineers.

title: Product Engineer - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
## The Role
We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.
This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
## What You'll Own
Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.
Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.
Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.
Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.
Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.
Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.
Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.
## What We're Looking For
Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.
Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.
Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.
Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.
Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.
High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.
Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.
## The Kind of Builder We Want
Starts from user problems, not feature lists.
Can make decisions with incomplete information.
Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.
Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.
Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.
## This Role Is Not For
People who only write decks and do not drive execution.
PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.
Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.
People who launch features and then stop caring.
PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.
## Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.
## Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
## Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Software Engineer, Security, Stablecoin
description:
## About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
## About the Role
Ramp is, at its core, a fintech company. Our financial infrastructure enables us to issue cards, move money globally, and manage treasury flows for our customers. Stablecoins are emerging as a critical lever to make these flows faster, cheaper, and more accessible.
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our engineering team with a dedicated focus on stablecoin-based payment and treasury systems. In this role, you will act as both a technical owner and multiplier: working on core stablecoin services, ensuring secure and reliable integrations with external partners, and guiding Ramp’s evolution toward next-generation fintech solutions.
Our ideal candidate combines deep curiosity about eventually consistent distributed systems with strong financial infrastructure experience, thrives in highly regulated and mission-critical environments, and has a passion for diving into new problem spaces.
## What You'll Do
Help build & scale Ramp’s stablecoin-based payment and treasury infrastructure
Partner with external providers and internal stakeholders to deliver end-to-end product flows
Solve Ramp’s toughest fintech challenges with new technologies
Collaborate with engineers across Ramp to integrate stablecoin capabilities into core products
## What You Need
Minimum 5+ years of experience shipping high-quality architectures for critical systems preferred
Proven experience with stablecoin technologies, blockchain-based payment rails, and/or wallet infrastructure
Strong production experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or equivalent)
Deep proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (Python, Go, Java, or similar)
Experience working on security-sensitive systems, with interest in key management, wallet security, or secure transaction flows.
Experience building or operating payments, money movement, treasury, stablecoin, or crypto infrastructure in production environments
## Nice to Have
Intuition for on-chain UX and settlement mechanics, including wallet-based transaction signing, confirmation/finality, and chain-level tradeoffs like fees and latency.
Direct experience building on-chain wallets or with integrating a crypto onramp / offramp APIs for custody and remittance flows
Experience integrating with external financial service providers and APIs at scale
Familiarity with cross-border settlement, FX, or treasury management systems
Background in highly regulated fintech environments (e.g., payments, banking, or government-compliant infrastructure)
## Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)
Flexible PTO
Centralized home-office equipment ordering
Health and wellness stipend
Budget for intra-office travel
Weekly coffee stipend
## United States
100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
One Medical annual membership
401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
Pet insurance
In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
## Canada
Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
Life, AD&D, and disability coverage
Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)
Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
